The Global Platform for the South brings together universities, governments, businesses, innovators, researchers, civil society, artists, and communities to co-create knowledge, solutions, and opportunities for the Global South.

GPS Pillar 04 — private sector, industry, start-ups, investment, business partnerships, and executive education across the Global South.
GPS Pillar 02 — AI, digital transformation, innovation labs, entrepreneurship, smart agriculture, and health innovation for the Global South.
